<blockquote>Hmmz, what does the |* do? [[User:Gherald|Gherald]]</blockquote>
Piping category links does something completely different than piping regular links, surprisingly; it allows you to 'sort' the category's entries in some other way than strictly alphabetical. [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Piped_link] The * keeps the OT template at the top and separate from all of the Old Tongue words that will eventually be sorted into here...
